concept: RDS Read Replicas: offload reads from the primary
tests: Scaling reads separately from the transactional load when a small replication lag is acceptable.
expected: Add RDS read replicas and point reporting queries at their endpoint. Triggers: "read-heavy", "reports slow down transactions", "data a few seconds stale is acceptable" ⇒ asynchronous replicas.
why_not: Multi-AZ standby does not serve reads (failover only); scaling up hits a ceiling and does not isolate analytics; strongly consistent reads from the primary keep the resource contention.
